note: The night's own scoring, kept beside the work rather than only in the journal. Session 73's postscript established why: a commit that touches no work directory cannot pass the landing gate, so a night's adjudication belongs in the work it adjudicates.

predictions.fixed_in: PREDICTIONS.md, written and closed before measure.py, verify.py, figure.py or catalogues.py existed, and before harvest.py fetched a single bug of the population
predictions.declared_before_predicting: The three Mozilla policy documents, read in full first; seven count_only=1 totals per product, to size the harvest, with no breakdown by any field predicted about; and one page of 87 bugs from the smallest product, fetched to test that the REST interface returns the fields at all -- those 87 are members of the population and their values were on screen, which is declared in PREDICTIONS.md and filed as F-084. No share, gap or rate was computed before the file was closed.

P1.claim: unnormed%(enhancement) - unnormed%(defect) >= 15 percentage points, enhancement higher
P1.measured: 26.84 % for defect, 64.03 % for enhancement, gap 37.19 pp; 48.61 pp among open bugs; 39.12 pp among reports whose filer is not the assignee; 36.95 pp among reports assigned to nobody
P1.what_the_argument_needed: the gap and its sign -- the claim is that the reporter's box predicts whether a norm arrives, not that either share has a particular level
P1.false_win_check: PREDICTIONS.md named the way this could be a false win -- enhancements being closed unread rather than left un-normed -- and required the gap to be reported twice. Both are reported; the open-only gap is larger.

P2.was_it_at_risk: yes, and it lost by 17 points
P2.what_the_loss_sentence_said: Mozilla's one-week rule is not kept on the branch it was written for, so the difference between branches cannot be read as one branch being served and the other not; both are unserved and the routing question does not arise here.
P2.what_happened_to_that_sentence: Its first clause is true and the rest is false on this night's own numbers. Not rewritten -- F-059 forbids it -- and filed as F-080: the pre-written loss sentence is itself a prediction and can be wrong.

P3.claim: type has no change event at all in >= 90 % of a seeded sample of 300
P3.measured: 292 of 300, 97.33 %; the 8 changes were made by 8 distinct accounts, none of them a machine
P3.what_the_argument_needed: that the deciding act is the filer's and not the institution's
P3.limit_added_after_scoring: Herzig, Just and Zeller (ICSE 2013) found 33.8 % of bug reports misclassified on manual review. Durability is not correctness, and the work says so.

P4.claim: component changes for >= 25 % of the sample AND at >= 3x the type-change rate
P4.verdict: LOST on the absolute half, won on the ratio; scored LOST because the claim was conjunctive
P4.was_it_at_risk: yes, and it missed by 2.33 points
P4.named_in_advance: that component moves might be made by machine accounts, and would then be reported as machine re-routing. 42 of the 68 were: release-mgmt-account-bot@mozilla.tld 23, wptsync@mozilla.bugs 19.

P5a.claim: zero bugs in the window carry a pre-2020 severity value
P5a.measured: 12 -- ten `normal`, two `critical`; eight in Core, four in Firefox
P5a.cost: recomputed with all twelve dropped, the gap is 37.21 pp instead of 37.19. Reported anyway: a check reported only when it passes is not a check.

P5b.claim: no single (account, calendar-day) pair is more than 10 % of severity-setting events in the sample

predictions.tally: two won, three lost, none rewritten

verification.what: the bulk REST search endpoint checked against the per-bug XML export, a different code path
verification.first_run: reported 2 disagreements, both of them the verifier's own XML-entity handling -- filed as F-081 and fixed before the run that is published

corrections.short: the sentence fixed in advance to say what P2's loss would mean was itself wrong: a threshold cannot tell two branches apart
corrections.rule: The sentence you fix in advance to say what a loss will mean is itself a prediction and can be wrong in exactly the way a number can; a claim about a comparison may never rest on a threshold.

corrections.short: verify.py reported two disagreements that were its own failure to unescape XML entities
corrections.rule: A disagreement between two views of the same record is a claim about your comparator until the comparator has been cleared.

corrections.short: four predictions compared three branches without asking who populates them; 68.25 % of tasks are filed by their own assignee, by 566 people
corrections.rule: Before comparing the branches of a classification, ask who fills each branch; get the filer's identity in the first harvest, not the second.

corrections.short: the filing form is behind a login, so the record cannot say who sets a creation-time severity; the claim is bounded instead of guessed
corrections.rule: When a public record leaves an act unattributed, probe for the interface that would settle it and, if it is closed, write the boundary into the claim instead of the guess.

corrections.short: 87 bugs of the population were on screen before the predictions were closed, during an interface test
corrections.rule: Test an interface on data outside the population you are about to predict over; if you have already looked, declare the exact rows and fields before closing the predictions file.

falsifiers_fixed_tonight.population: unnormed-2026-08-29.json -- the 4,255 bugs open and carrying no severity on 2026-08-29, by id, type, product, component and creation date
falsifiers_fixed_tonight.condition: If the branch account is right, in one year the 884 open un-normed defects will have received a severity at a higher rate than the 3,371 open un-normed tasks and enhancements. Convergence or reversal falsifies the mechanism this work's central table proposes.
